summary: Honeywell Aerospace Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completed spin-off from Honeywell International Inc. effective June 29, 2026. The transaction was effected through a pro rata distribution of one share of Honeywell Aerospace common stock for every two shares of Honeywell International common stock held as of the June 15 record date. No price per share or premium was involved as it was a tax-free distribution to existing shareholders. The company now trades as an independent public company on Nasdaq under ticker HONA. Definitive agreements including separation, transition services, tax matters, and intellectual property licenses were executed. Watch for post-spin trading dynamics and potential index inclusion.
